hotels.title: Hong Kong Harbourside Luxury with Skyline Views
hotels.description: Stay only steps away from Kowloon's Tsim Sha Tsui East shopping district at the luxe Kerry Hotel, Hong Kong, a glamorous city escape from the world-renowned Shangri-La collection on the fringes of Kowloon Bay. When you're not admiring the harbour views from almost every vantage point in the hotel, tantalise your tastebuds at one of the three onsite restaurants. Load up your plates at Big Bay Café for a buffet lunch, feast on dim sum at Hung Tong, or be spoilt for choice at Dockyard, a gourmet food hall. For a romantic date night in a sultry setting, Red Sugar boasts an impressive collection of craft beers, world wines and creative cocktails. Between time exploring Kowloon and Hong Kong's sights, retreat to the spa, a tranquil haven where signature massages, brightening facials and shea butter infusions will leave you feeling brand new.

hotels.title: Hong Kong Harbourside Glamour with Daily Breakfast, Club Lounge Access & One Child Stays Free
hotels.description: There are few more spectacular views of Victoria Harbour than from Shangri-La's Kerry Hotel, Hong Kong. Whether you're living the good life at the private Club Lounge (access included), lazing by the spectacular infinity pool or taking a breather in your city view room, a constant panorama of Hong Kong reminds that you've struck gold. Treat yourself to a glamorous stay only steps away from Kowloon’s Tsim Sha Tsui East shopping district at this city escape on the fringes of Hung Hom Bay. When you’re not admiring the harbour from the infinity pool, feast on dim sum at Hung Tong, be spoilt for choice in Dockyard's gourmet food hall or enjoy a romantic date night at Red Sugar. Plus, with one child staying free with Club Lounge access included, you're all set for the ultimate family escape. Between time exploring Kowloon and Hong Kong’s sights, retreat to the opulent spa at Base Camp Kerry Sports, a tranquil haven where signature massages, brightening facials and shea butter infusions will leave you feeling brand-new. Take a luxurious swim at the indoor pool, or simply grab a cabana on the balcony and watch the waters of Victoria Harbour sparkle in the sunlight.
